mods.name: Cytra Area Scanner
mods.changelog:
- Enabled switch (Scanner tab): off stops the running scan, the overlay, the HUD and the scan hotkeys. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

Needs Litematica 0.26.16+ and MaLiLib 0.27.20+.

mods.name: Cytra Bot Macros
mods.changelog:
- Client on/off switch: clientEnabled in config.json and /bm enable | /bm disable. Off: keys, hotkeys, quick add and starting macros from this client do nothing; running and server macros keep going. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

mods.name: Cytra Carpet
mods.changelog: - Mod icon (Cytra logo) in Mod Menu. No other changes.

mods.name: Cytra Container
mods.changelog:
- Get Materials pulls only what's still needed for that material list
- Works with Carpet's stacked shulker boxes: an empty box is split off a stack and filled
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

Client needs Litematica 0.26.16+ and MaLiLib 0.27.20+. The server part is optional.

mods.name: Cytra Hub
mods.changelog:
- New Updates tab: see which Cytra mods have updates, read the changelog, and install them on the next restart (or Quit & apply)
- Downloads are checked (SHA-256, only from SteelAspect/cytra-releases); a small helper swaps the jars after the game closes, and can update Cytra Hub itself
- Optional auto-update, plus toasts when updates are available or were installed
- Commands tab on each mod page (from 0.2.0): every command you can use, click to type it into chat
